summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Production-Grade Digital Signage & TV Ad Network system, including the dual-mode Android TV Display Client (Media3 ExoPlayer gapless playback, 3.5s watchdog, offline caching, 6-digit pairing, orientation/scale controls, PIN-protected Admin Panel) and CMS Dashboard (Firestore real-time sync, 600KB chunked ingestion, zone permissions, live monitor, and A/B OTA Software Update & Rollback manager).
